cases.caption: A long jumper demonstrates a flawed technique, resulting in a short distance and an unbalanced landing.
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A long jumper demonstrates a flawed technique, resulting in a short distance and an unbalanced landing. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The long jumper must initiate the jump with a clear takeoff phase, showing a forward lean and arm swing for momentum.
The jumper's body must be observed mid-air, displaying an unbalanced posture that deviates from optimal form, such as excessive hip drop or uneven leg extension.
The landing phase must visibly show a short distance from the takeoff point, with the jumper's feet landing close together or in an uncontrolled manner.
The jumper's final position must indicate instability, such as a staggered stance or a loss of balance immediately after landing.

cases.caption: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
cases.action: pulling two ends of something so that it gets stretched
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: Two people must be positioned at opposite ends of the bungee cord to apply tension.
The cord must be stretched until it reaches its maximum elastic extension.
The cord should remain taut and fully extended without snapping or breaking.
The stretching action must be performed gradually to avoid sudden release or loss of control.

evaluation.average_definition: mean of (SA + PC) / 2; custom summary, not official Joint Score
evaluation.missing_policy: no final comparison unless every selected case has both valid SA and PC scores

scope: Four-case diagnostic subset of shared-first-image VideoPhy2 I2V; not a benchmark-wide score
input_scope: First image, caption and original first/caption requirements only
paired_control: Same checkpoint including trained Wan LoRA; only C strength changes in both CFG arms
selection: Fixed before this ablation: jump, wet-canvas twisting, elastic-cord stretching, parachute unfolding
